comments:
597d8629: ; Incomplete Records Tracking package install entry point.
;
; Checks environment and sets:
;   XPDABORT=null if installation proceeds
;            =2 if aborted for any reason

fb6e5abf: ; Main entry point.
;
; Checks if required programming variables are properly set,
; and that the DGJ package version 1.0 has been loaded.
; If checks fail, sets XPDABORT=2 and branches to ABRT label.
; If all checks pass, displays "Environment check complete and okay."

b2b0b469: Check if DUZ (current user), DUZ(0) (kernel access code), DT (current date/time), and $ZDATA special variable U (coding node delimiter) are properly set. If not, branch to ABRT label after displaying error messages.
b5b0644f: Calls BMES^XPDUTL to display "*****" banner message
615cc472: Calls MES^XPDUTL to display "Your programming variables are not set up properly."
991ffe26: Check if version of 'DGJ' package is 1.0. If not, branch to ABRT label after displaying error messages.
5b3081b4: Calls BMES^XPDUTL to display "*****" banner message
8f464e49: Calls MES^XPDUTL to display "VERSION 1.0 OF INCOMPLETE RECORDS TRACKING HAS NOT BEEN LOADED."
1f5dcaf2: Writes ">> Environment check complete and okay." to current device
0a10cdea: Sets XPDABORT=2 and exits the current execution context
